metadata.test_suite: Chapter 5 System Robustness and OTA Reliability

test_cases.name: Corrupted Hash Rejection
test_cases.expected_result: Status 'failed' (Hash mismatch), temporary file removed, active model unchanged
test_cases.actual_result: Hash verification check rejected corrupted SHA-256 digest before load

test_cases.name: Malformed File Rejection
test_cases.expected_result: Trial-load throws exception, status 'failed' (Load error), memory untouched
test_cases.actual_result: Trial-load joblib.load() threw exception; .tmp discarded and active model preserved

test_cases.name: Valid Model Hot-Swap
test_cases.expected_result: Model swapped via model_lock and atomically persisted, zero container restarts
test_cases.actual_result: Valid SHA-256 verified, trial-load passed, atomic os.replace() executed, zero downtime

test_cases.name: MQTT Broker Dropout Reconnect
test_cases.expected_result: Edge services loop-retry connection every 3 seconds without process termination
test_cases.actual_result: Sensor simulator and inference engine reconnect loops retry with backoff; no process exit

test_cases.name: Crash Recovery & SQLite WAL Integrity
test_cases.expected_result: PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL ensures zero DB corruption; checkpoint.json resumes row index
test_cases.actual_result: SQLite integrity check: 'ok', Journal mode: 'WAL'; atomic checkpointing intact
